name: knowchamp-admin-fullstack
description: Fullstack Quiz App Admin Panel & Backend runner

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin install
